description: This file is a Zephyr-based C source code implementing an OpenAMP remote application, managing RPMsg communication, shared memory, and threading for inter-processor communication.

methods.name: platform_init
methods.description: Initializes shared memory, resource table, and IPM for communication setup.

methods.name: platform_create_rpmsg_vdev
methods.description: Creates and initializes a virtio RPMsg device for communication.

methods.name: cleanup_system
methods.description: Cleans up resources, disables IPM, and deinitializes RPMsg.

methods.name: receive_message
methods.description: Waits for a message semaphore and triggers notification.

methods.name: mailbox_notify
methods.description: Sends a message via IPM notification.

methods.name: new_service_cb
methods.description: Callback for unexpected namespace service receive.

methods.name: rpmsg_mng_task
methods.description: Main task managing the RPMsg communication, including initialization and message handling loop.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that creates application threads for RPMsg client, TTY, and management.
